what: A groovebox built on SLOOP: three synth tracks, drums, a step sequencer and song mode. Hold ENV for the SYNTH MODE: three wavetable oscillators, an envelope and an LFO for each, and an FX chain you build. A parallel FX mixer, a glue compressor and an EQ on the master.
